thesis: Pre-open news pack for 2026-09-04 is diffuse and dominated by high-level geopolitical commentary (Saudi investment summit RSVPs, Chinese tech expansion in Saudi Arabia, Ukraine budget warnings), Florida medical cannabis headwinds, Genesco (GCO) retail earnings analysis, routine politician transaction filings, and carryover items from previous sessions. None of these headlines present an actionable fundamental catalyst or sector rotation signal for our US equity/ETF portfolio. Our existing balanced 4-position book—holding broad equity core VTI, fixed-income ballast BND, and technology sleeves NVDA and XLK—remains properly diversified (cap 6), keeps all position weights well under the 35% single-name cap (VTI ~28%, NVDA ~18%), and preserves $35.00 cash (~32% of equity, comfortably exceeding the 15% floor). Holding all positions maintains portfolio discipline without forcing turnover on weak pre-market evidence.
